title: Final pressure (isothermal)
description: Essential: Correctly states the final pressure after isothermal expansion as p = p₀/2.

title: Final pressure (heating)
description: Essential: Correctly states the final pressure after heating as p' = 1.2p = 0.6p₀.

title: Heat absorbed
description: Essential: Correctly states the heat absorbed as Q = 0.2 k T₀.

title: Apply ideal gas law
description: Important: Uses Boyle's law for the isothermal expansion into the vacuum.

title: Apply first law
description: Important: Applies the first law of thermodynamics, Q = ΔU - W, for the heating process.

title: Recognize zero work
description: Important: Identifies that no work is done during the constant-volume heating.

title: Use given ΔU relation
description: Important: Correctly uses the provided relation ΔU = k(T₂ - T₁) to find the internal energy change.

title: Incorrect final pressure
description: Pitfall: States a final pressure other than p₀/2 for part (1) or 0.6p₀ for part (2).

title: Misapplies work term
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates non-zero work for the isochoric heating process.
